canada.title: Crews work to contain fire at Halifax Grain Elevator

canada.summary: Crowds of supporters gathered outside the Federal Court building in Vancouver on Monday in solidarity with plaintiffs in Canada's first youth-led climate trial.

canada.title: Alvin Tedjo beats out Parrish and Crombie to become new mayor of Mississauga
canada.summary: It appears that Alvin Tedjo will be Mississauga’s new mayor following a tough-fought race in which he beat out two women who previously held the job. With 135 of 181 polls reporting, the CP24-CTV Election Desk is projecting Tedjo will win the Mississauga mayoral race.

canada.summary: A 19-year-old man is dead and five other people were injured after a vehicle collided with a semi-truck south of Winnipeg on Saturday.

canada.title: Montreal police officer who allegedly urinated on homeless people faces ethics probe
canada.summary: Guy Lapointe Jr., Quebec's new domestic security, said both the police ethics commissioner and the province's independent police watchdog, known as the BEI, will look into the allegations.

canada.title: Ex-N.S. PC interim leader endorses another former Tory for Liberal leadership
canada.summary: A former interim leader of Nova Scotia's Progressive Conservatives has endorsed her former PC cabinet colleague to become the new provincial Liberal leader.

canada.title: Northerners among youth taking climate fight to federal court
canada.summary: Kira Young of Yellowknife and Leandrea Reeves of Whitehorse are among 15 young plaintiffs who've filed a lawsuit against the federal government over climate change. The trial is scheduled to begin Monday, where they'll argue the trajectory of greenhouse gas emissions causes harm and violates their rights.
